FN-TB3DG91-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 562
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/15/2025
House Bill 562as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Office of the
State Auditor to: (1) adjust every four years, and notify agency property managers, of any
increases in the threshold value of state property to be inventoried; and (2) establish the Division
of Investigations to investigate instances of lost or stolen damaged state property owned by state
entities. According to the State Auditor, these additional duties would not require any additional
funding.
Page 1
